Object operations for managing all object kinds in the system.

This command group provides operations that work across all object kinds:
  Common operations: create, get, list, update, delete, count
  Relationship traversal: related, path, neighbors
  Specialized operations: bulk (batch operations)
  Kind-based operations: <kind> fields (explore fields for a specific kind)

Examples:
  # Common operations (work for all object kinds)
  zqk object create backlog_item --file item.yaml
  zqk object list backlog_item --filter status=exploring
  zqk object get ITEM-626
  zqk object update ITEM-626 --field status=validated
  zqk object delete ITEM-626
  zqk object count backlog_item
  zqk object backlog_item fields

  # Specialized operations
  zqk object bulk create backlog_item --file items.yaml
  zqk object bulk update --file updates.yaml

Usage:
  zqk object [command]

Available Commands:
  <kind>      Operations for a specific object kind
  count       Count objects by kind
  create      Create a new object
  delete      Delete an object by ID
  demote      Demote one or more objects to a lower lifecycle status
  evoman      Evolution management operations
  export      Export objects to YAML or JSON
  fields      List object kinds or explore fields (use object <kind> fields for a specific kind)
  get         Get an object by ID
  import      Import objects from YAML or JSON file
  list        List objects of a specific kind
  move        Move an object to a different directory/kind
  neighbors   Find immediate neighbors of an object (depth=1)
  path        Find a path between two objects via reference relationships
  pplan       Priority plan operations (current, next, prev, add, remove)
  promote     Promote one or more objects to the highest valid lifecycle status they satisfy
  related     Find objects related to an object via reference fields
  rename      Rename an object (change its ID)
  splan       Strategic plan operations
  template    Generate a blank template for creating an object
  update      Update an existing object
  wstrans     Workstream transition operations

Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk object [command] --help" for more information about a command.
